structured.answer: Cheapest stock-index kupat gemel lehashkaa is a tie at 0.56% management fee (0% on deposits): הראל (15040) and אלטשולר שחם (14864); I'd go with הראל since it's on top and a name I know.

Both 0.56%, page gives no hint how to choose between them
Arrow made me think it was sorted by fee; it isn't
Hesitated between 'עוקב מדדי מניות' and 'עוקב מדד s&p 500'
